c1-28-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How Well the Line Is Used
c1-28-01.scenario: Károly asks how well the railway line is used in the morning.
c1-28-01.prompt: Tell Károly how far the line is used in the morning.
cues: Say how far the capacity is used
c1-28-01.target: A vonal kapacitását reggel teljes mértékben kihasználják.
c1-28-01.english: The line's capacity is used to the full in the morning.
c1-28-01.canDo: I can say how well a line or a network works with a degree adverb (*teljes mértékben*, *kiemelkedően*, *részben*, *alig*).

c1-28-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Terminal
c1-28-02.scenario: Károly asks what a new terminal is good for. You have read that it links the train with the bus.
c1-28-02.prompt: Tell Károly what the terminal does.
c1-28-02.target: A vasutat a busszal összekapcsoló terminál megkönnyíti az átszállást.
c1-28-02.english: The terminal that links the railway with the bus makes changing easier.
c1-28-02.canDo: I can describe a link between modes of transport with a participle before the noun (*a vasutat a busszal összekapcsoló*, *a közutat tehermentesítő*).

c1-28-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Bus and Train
c1-28-03.scenario: Károly asks how a bus and a train differ.
c1-28-03.prompt: Contrast the bus and the train.
cues: Say what the bus is good for
c1-28-03.target: A busz a városon belül gyors, a vonat viszont a távolsági utakon.
c1-28-03.english: The bus is fast inside the city; the train, however, on long-distance journeys.
c1-28-03.canDo: I can set one way of travelling against another with *szemben*, *viszont* and *míg … addig*.

c1-28-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Track Was Renewed
c1-28-04.scenario: Károly asks why the railway track was renewed. You have read that it was done to reduce the travel time.
c1-28-04.prompt: Tell Károly why the track was renewed.
c1-28-04.target: A menetidő csökkentése érdekében felújították a vasúti pályát.
c1-28-04.english: In the interest of reducing travel time, they renewed the railway track.
c1-28-04.canDo: I can state the aim of a railway investment with *céljából*, *végett* and *érdekében*.

c1-28-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Zone Tariff
c1-28-05.scenario: You have read about the zone tariff of 1889. Károly asks what happened to the number of passengers.
c1-28-05.prompt: Tell Károly how big the change was.
cues: Say how big the change was
c1-28-05.target: A zónatarifa után az utasok száma jelentősen nőtt.
c1-28-05.english: After the zone tariff the number of passengers grew considerably.
c1-28-05.canDo: I can say how big the effect of a reform was with a degree adverb (*számottevően*, *jelentősen*, *alapjaiban*).

c1-28-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Zone Tariff in Two Sentences
c1-28-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you to sum up in two sentences what the zone tariff of 1889 was.
c1-28-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly when the zone tariff came into force and what changed.
cues: Say when it came into force
c1-28-consolidation.target: A zónatarifa 1889. augusztus 1-jén lépett életbe. A távolsági jegyek ára csökkent, az utasok száma jelentősen nőtt.
c1-28-consolidation.english: The zone tariff came into force on 1 August 1889. The price of long-distance tickets fell and the number of passengers grew considerably.
c1-28-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for railway networks, modes of transport, modernization and the zone tariff.
